name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_refresh_list_timer
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::OnRefreshListTimer ticks unscaled time, optionally pumps WOL callbacks, auto-refreshes list mode 17 at the refresh deadline, and falls through to CWnd::Default.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja reconstruction is limited because the original x87 compare scaffolding is represented at source level as a float deadline comparison.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43dfe0 validates Time::Tick, the process-callbacks flag at 0x4f53cc, COM ProcessCallbacks dispatch through vtable offset 0x0c, the unscaled-time/next-refresh comparison, next-refresh update by 60 seconds, COM RequestListMode dispatch through vtable offset 0x18 with mode 17 enabled, and final CWnd::Default dispatch.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_refresh_list_timer_smoke patches Time::Tick, uses the linked test CWnd::Default provider, and verifies callbacks-disabled, callbacks-before-deadline, and callbacks-at-deadline paths including COM call counts, RequestListMode arguments, and next-refresh time update.
